name: Tụ lực lưỡi đao (lửa)
desc: fire that catches along a weapon: a source ignites at the hilt, the fire spreads along the blade to the tip with a bright head, flat flame tongues (orange, amber, pale core) of different sizes lick up from the lit blade and flicker on twos, embers rise and shrink; discreet (it is a status) and it does not fade out; same timeline and drawing core as charge_blue
